questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Det der var mest vigtigt for mig var at skolen kunne tilbyde mig stor faglig udfordring. Samtidig en skole i et land hvor jeg forstod sproget da det ville være nemmere i undervisningen men også socialt.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Det var super nemt. Skolen var gode til at sende mange mails med de vigtigste informationer.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Ikke noget

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Jeg ville klart bo i et townhouse til en anden gang, mere i kanten af byen og sammen med andre unge. Det er er også en del billigere man skal bare være klar på at betale for hele tiden man er der på forhånd.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: At hvis man tager afsted alene er det nok federe at bo on campus. Det er nemmere at komme ind i sociale relationer.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Det var super nemt. Man kunne melde sig på forskellige tidpunkter at komme op på skolen og få det gjort. Det tog max. 5 minutter og de var super fleksible.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Skolen havde op til flere kontore man både kunne ringe til eller bare dukke op.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Det gik super. Vi ændrede nogle klasser da vi kom da vi fandt ud af de ikke gav mening for os alligevel. Allerede dagen efter var de nye fag godkendt.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Jeg har ikke noget ud over at husk at læse de mails de sender jer i starten.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Man skal ikke blive chokerede over karakterene der. De dømmer lidt hårdere end vi er vandt til men samtidig er der også stor forskel i måde man bliver undervist på og generelt stor forskelighed på æstetik.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Lærerne guider dig meget mere i Sheffield. Du har generelt mindre at sige om dine egne projekter og der er en klar forventning om at du følger hvad lærerne synes du skal gøre designmæssigt.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
-The changing landscape
- Landscape design- Exploration and intervention
- Materials of Landscape- Construction design

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Materials of landscape. Klart det fedeste fag, hvor jeg virkelig lærte meget nyt. En god blanding af forlæsninger og arbejde selv. Du bliver virkelig god til AutoCad. OBS- faget kan kun tages hvis du har taget Landscape Design.

What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Nothing

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Det er lidt billigere at handle der, og man skal ikke bruge pege på bøger. Man kan også godt finde lidt billegere husleje end vi gjorde hvis man ikke bord i studieboliger. Computere er på skolen som man kan bruge gratis. Super dyrt at printe.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: De har en social klub for alt du kunne forstille dig.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Jeg deltog desværre ikke i nogen af dem, men der er en hiking klub jeg fortrød ikke at være en del af. Det så super hyggeligt ud og de tog på mange ture i Peak District.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Tag en masse til Peak district og vandre. Hvis man har råd klart tag til Skotland! ellers er det nemt at komme til andre byer med tog fra Sheffield. Både Manchester og York er gode bud kun en times tid derfra.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Super nemt. Folk er super åbne og man skal næsten vende sig til hvor mange fremmede der snakker til en.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Deltag i så mange ting som du har overskud til i starten, så for man hurtigt nogle venner.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Nej det synes jeg ikke.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Uhh det er svært at sige. Jeg synes ikke der er den helt store forskel. Jeg synes det var skønt hvor sociale og udadvendte alle er.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1. Søg en masse legater også mens du er afsted. Det er fedt at have penge til at kunne opleve en masse i stedet for bare at "overleve"
2. Prøv at deltage i en masse socialt i starten, Det gør det nemmere senere hen.
3. Husk at skolen unerviser på en anden måde og ikke age det som et nederlag at du får en lavere karakter her end du normalt gør derhjemme.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Jeg tror det hele er givet videre

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Alle de søde mennesker man møder. Samtdig med jeg føler jeg har udviklet mig selv enormt meget og blevet endnu bedre til engelsk.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: At skulle snakke engelsk hele tiden. I starten kunne jeg godt mærke det lå lidt langt væk og man blev lidt genert. Men man kommer hurtigt ind i det og folk er super søde til at hjælpe en.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
